headline: Avengers: Doomsday trailer shatters Disney record
post:
Avengers: Doomsday pulled in 563 million views in its first twenty-four hours to break a major Disney record. This massive number makes it the single most-viewed Disney trailer of all time. Yet, it still sits behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which reached 718.6 million views in the same timeframe.

Do you think Avengers: Doomsday will manage to top Spider-Man: Brand New Day at the box office?

original_title: Doomsday Just Shattered a Disney Record But One Avenger Still Has The Movie Beat

headline: Adam Driver reveals why Disney shelved Hunt for Ben Solo movie
post:
Adam Driver shared that Disney reportedly passed on the finished Hunt for Ben Solo script because the character is dead. The actor discussed the decision on the Talk Easy podcast with Sam Fragoso, noting the reason provided by the studio. Lucasfilm had supported the project helmed by Steven Soderbergh before it was shelved. Updates will follow.

headline: Kate Bishop and Cassie Lang unite in Doomsday
post:
Marvel Studios has introduced plenty of next-generation heroes during the Multiverse Saga. According to Screen Rant, the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday features a shot of Hailee Steinfeld returning as Kate Bishop alongside Cassie Lang in what looks to be her New York apartment. This exciting appearance marks Kate's first return since her Disney+ debut in 2021's Hawkeye and her cameo in 2023's The Marvels. 🎬

During the end of The Marvels, Kamala Khan recruited Kate for a team of young heroes while mentioning Cassie as another potential member. The fact that Kate and Cassie are now together suggests that some crucial assembly may have been happening off-screen.

While the trailer does not officially establish a full Young Avengers roster, it supports the theories about the team's future in the MCU. Avengers: Doomsday releases in theaters on December 18, 2026. Which other young hero do you hope joins them next? 

#AvengersDoomsday #KateBishop #YoungAvengers
original_title: Avengers: Doomsday’s Final Trailer Supports The Biggest Young Avengers Theory

headline: Toxic Avenger inspired 1991 children's toys
post:
The Toxic Avenger somehow inspired a 1991 children's action figure line called Toxic Crusaders. Playmates manufactured the neon-colored toys alongside a brief thirteen-episode cartoon season that same year.

Nine figures and five vehicles were produced, featuring characters like Nozone and Headbanger with glow-in-the-dark accessories. Today, rare pieces command a premium among dedicated cult collectors.

Would you hunt down a rare Apocalypse Attackcopter vehicle or stick to collecting the original heroes?

#Entertainment #Hollywood #PopCulture
original_title: One of the 80s’ Most Inappropriate Superheroes Somehow Got His Own Children’s Toy Line

headline: Peter Quill is now King of Outer Space
post:
Peter Quill has a shocking new dark title, according to Screen Rant. Marvel has reportedly redefined the hero's cosmic status, with a godlike villain known as Kingkiller addressing him as the "King of Outer Space" in Black Panther/Namor: Doomed #3. 

This darker evolution places Peter right alongside powerful rulers like Black Panther, Namor, and Doctor Doom. While close friends like Nova reportedly disapprove of his new leadership role heading a galactic union, even cosmic entities now recognize his reign. 

With danger closing in, the former Star-Lord is reportedly ready to reach out to his old teammates. Do you want to see Peter reunite with the Guardians? 🚀

#StarLord #MarvelComics #GuardiansOfTheGalaxy
original_title: Star-Lord's New Codename Confirmed By Marvel

headline: Destruction AllStars servers shutting down forever
post:
Destruction AllStars is shutting down for good in less than twenty-four hours. PlayStation is officially pulling the plug on the 2021 car combat exclusive tomorrow, November 25th. Lucid Games originally developed the live-service title before support for it began to wane.

Single-player modes have remained accessible since the multiplayer functionality ended in May. Now, this is the very last chance to play the game before it becomes completely unplayable.

Did you ever play Destruction AllStars, or will you miss it?

#DestructionAllStars #PlayStation #PS5
original_title: PS5 Exclusive Game From 2021 Is Shutting Down Forever in Under 24 Hours
